description: We are a two-person team passionate about technology, space exploration and innovation. We are building ERTHIVA, an interactive Earth intelligence platform that combines NASA data, realistic 3D visualizations and an intuitive interface to make understanding our planet accessible to everyone. We welcome collaborators interested in GIS, remote sensing, environmental science, 3D development, frontend engineering and UI/UX design who want to turn ambitious ideas into reality.
summary: ERTHIVA is an interactive Earth science platform designed to help users explore environmental changes across different regions and time periods. By combining NASA Earth science data with statistical analysis and interactive visualizations, ERTHIVA helps identify trends, measure their magnitude, and understand how environmental variables change across our planet.
details:
ERTHIVA — Earth Science Trend Detection and Analysis Platform

About the Project

ERTHIVA is an interactive Earth science platform designed to help people explore, analyze, and understand how Earth's environmental systems change over time and across different geographical regions.

Environmental changes do not happen uniformly across the planet. The same variable may increase in one region while decreasing in another. Global averages alone can sometimes hide these important regional differences. ERTHIVA addresses this challenge by bringing Earth science data, statistical analysis, and interactive visualization together in one accessible platform.

What Does It Do and How Does It Work?

ERTHIVA allows users to explore Earth science information and investigate environmental trends across different locations and time periods.

The platform integrates NASA resources, including NASA POWER and NASA's Earth Observatory Natural Event Tracker (EONET), to support the exploration of environmental variables and natural events.

Its statistical analysis engine applies established analytical methods, including:

  • Linear Regression to examine trends over time.
  • Mann-Kendall Test to identify statistically significant monotonic trends.
  • Sen's Slope Estimator to measure the magnitude and direction of change.
  • Correlation Analysis to examine relationships between variables.

The results are presented through interactive visualizations, helping users interpret environmental patterns and investigate how changes differ between regions.

Benefits and Intended Impact

ERTHIVA aims to make complex Earth science information more accessible and understandable.

Its intended benefits include:

  • Helping users identify increasing and decreasing environmental trends.
  • Making regional differences easier to investigate.
  • Providing statistical context rather than relying only on visual observations.
  • Helping users understand the magnitude and significance of environmental changes.
  • Encouraging data-driven exploration of Earth's interconnected environmental systems.

The broader goal is to support greater awareness and understanding of environmental change through accessible scientific data exploration.

Creativity and Innovation

The central idea behind ERTHIVA is to move beyond simply displaying environmental data and make it possible to investigate what that data actually tells us.

Instead of treating environmental change as a single global pattern, ERTHIVA emphasizes regional variation, statistical significance, and the direction and magnitude of change.

By bringing multiple statistical techniques and interactive visual exploration into one platform, ERTHIVA creates a more engaging way to investigate complex Earth science questions.

Technology and Development

ERTHIVA was developed as a web-based application using modern web development technologies.

Its technical components include:

  • TypeScript for application logic and statistical computations.
  • Firebase Authentication for user authentication.
  • Cloud Firestore for data storage.
  • Firebase Hosting for deployment and public accessibility.
  • Three.js for interactive 3D visual elements.
  • NASA POWER API and NASA EONET API for NASA-related data resources.
  • Google Fonts for typography.

The statistical analysis is implemented within the application's own analysis engine rather than relying on paid external AI APIs.

No specialized physical hardware is required to use the platform.

Design Considerations

During development, we considered scientific reliability, accessibility, usability, and performance.

Particular attention was given to using established statistical methods, presenting information in an understandable format, integrating relevant Earth science resources, and making the platform accessible through a web browser.

ERTHIVA is designed as an exploratory and analytical platform. Its purpose is to help users investigate environmental patterns and better understand Earth system changes, not to replace scientific research or expert interpretation.ERTHIVA — Earth Science Trend Detection and Analysis Platform
